explanation: This route is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because form parameter cid is percent-formatted directly into the DELETE query inside cur.execute(). An authenticated attacker posting crafted input in cid could alter the WHERE clause to delete all rows in Crawls. The repair attempts parameterization, but omits the comma between the SQL string literal and (cid,), which attempts to call the string as a function and raises TypeError at runtime.
